title: Apply layer (reducer)
instructions:
Implement the apply layer in game-core/src/engine/actions.ts (NO classes, NO mutation). This is the reducer: it turns a validated Action + GameState into a NEW GameState. It REUSES the existing modules — do NOT reimplement piles, draws, combat math, etc.

Imports (exact):
```ts
import type { GameState, Action, PlayerState, CardDef } from '../types';
import { validateAction } from './validate';
import { draw, discardHand } from './deck';
import { buyTopCard } from './market';
import { revealTop, sendToBottom, shuffleBack } from './mansion';
import { computeDamage, resolveExplore } from './explore';
import { flipDown, levelForDecorations } from './characters';
import { sumBonuses, applyBonusPools } from './cards';
import { advanceTurn } from './turn';
import { shuffle } from '../util/rng';
```

STYLE RULES: strict TypeScript with noUncheckedIndexedAccess. No `any`. No classes. No default exports. Never mutate inputs — return NEW state objects; any changed array is a NEW array; unchanged arrays may be shared BUT for safety always copy arrays you touch. Export ONLY: `export function applyAction(state: GameState, action: Action): GameState`. startGame is NOT handled here — it is built by game.ts setup (next task): if action.type === 'startGame' → `throw new Error('applyAction: startGame handled by game.ts setup')`.

ALGORITHM (top-level):
1. `const result = validateAction(state, action); if (!result.ok) throw new Error('applyAction: ' + result.reason);`
2. Build the new state by dispatching on action.type. Every branch returns a GameState with: `version: state.version + 1`, `rngState` updated whenever RNG was used (else keep state.rngState), `log: [...state.log, { seq: state.log.length + 1, action }]`. All other fields carried over (copied where changed).

Helper (private, not exported): `cardDef(state, instanceId)` identical to validate.ts's private helper: look up state.cards[instanceId], then state.cardDefs[inst.cardId]; undefined if either missing.

--- playActionCard { seat, instanceId } ---
- player = state.seats[seat] (validate already guaranteed existence).
- def = cardDef(state, instanceId).
- newHand = player.hand.filter(id => id !== instanceId); newPlayArea = [...player.playArea, instanceId]; actionsLeft = player.actionsLeft - 1.
- Bonuses: bonuses = sumBonuses([def]); pools = applyBonusPools({ turnAmmo: player.turnAmmo, turnGold: player.turnGold, actionsLeft, buysLeft: player.buysLeft, exploresLeft: player.exploresLeft }, bonuses). NOTE applyBonusPools returns { pools, draws }. So: turnAmmo/turnGold/actionsLeft/buysLeft/exploresLeft come from pools.pools; draws = pools.draws.
- Draws: if draws > 0 and player.inventory.length > 0: d = draw({ deck: player.inventory, discard: player.discard, reshuffledDiscard: [], count: draws }) → newHand = [...newHand, ...d.hand]; inventory = d.deck; discard = d.discard. (Fixture inventories are big enough that reshuffle never triggers in tests; still call draw correctly.)
- Immediate action effects: if def.actionEffects contains kind 'allWeaponsPlusDamageThisTurn' with amount a → weaponDamageBonusThisTurn = player.weaponDamageBonusThisTurn + a.
- Then rebuild the player object with ALL original fields (copy arrays) plus the changed ones.
- Prompt-requiring effects, in this priority (create AT MOST ONE prompt per action):
  a) recoverWeaponFromDiscardToHand: if player.discard has at least one instance whose def.type === 'weapon' → prompts += [{ id: 'p' + (state.prompts.length + 1), seat, text: def.text, options: <the weapon instance ids in discard, in discard order>, payload: { kind: 'recoverWeaponFromDiscardToHand' } }]. If none, no prompt.
  b) else moveHandCardToTopOfInventory: if newHand.length > 0 → prompt with options = newHand (in order), payload { kind: 'moveHandCardToTopOfInventory' }. If newHand empty, no prompt.
  c) else trashHandCard: if newHand.length > 0 → prompt with options = newHand, payload { kind: 'trashHandCard' }. Else no prompt.
  d) else (only lookAtMansionTop or negateWeaponCost40OrLessFromHand remain as prompt-requiring kinds): lookAtMansionTop → informational prompt options ['OK'], payload { kind: 'lookAtMansionTop' }; negateWeaponCost40OrLessFromHand → NO prompt (v1: reactive effect is a no-op, documented).
  IMPORTANT: use the FIRST prompt-requiring effect found in def.actionEffects order, not all of them (v1: one prompt per card play).
- seats = seats.map(s => s.seat === seat ? newPlayer : s).

--- playItem { seat, instanceId } ---
- def = cardDef(state, instanceId). The item is TRASHED on use: moved from hand to removed ALWAYS (Green Herb, First Aid Spray, Yellow Herb are all 'removed' per trashDestination semantics).
- newHand = hand minus instanceId; removed = [...state.removed, instanceId].
- Bonuses: same as playActionCard (sumBonuses + applyBonusPools + draws) — items may grant nothing in tests but implement generically.
- Item effects (v1):
  a) healToFull → hp = maxHp.
  b) plusMaxHp20 → maxHp = maxHp + 20 (hp unchanged).
  c) healFixed20OrTrashWithSecondFor60 → create prompt: options ['Heal 20', 'Heal 60'], payload { kind: 'healGreenHerb' }, text = def.text. The played herb is ALREADY in removed; resolution heals and (for option 1) trashes a second Green Herb from hand.
- Rebuild player, return state.

--- playAmmo { seat, instanceId } ---
- def = cardDef(state, instanceId). Ammo card goes to playArea (trashDestination = keep).
- newHand = hand minus instanceId; playArea += instanceId.
- Bonuses: sumBonuses([def]) → applyBonusPools (this is where +10 Ammo/+10 Gold lands: turnAmmo/turnGold). draws handled like playActionCard.
- Rebuild player, return state.

--- explore { seat, weapons, ammoCards, exploreCount } ---
- player = seats[seat]. exploredBy: exploresLeft = player.exploresLeft - exploreCount.
- Move ALL weapons and ammoCards: newHand = hand minus all of them; playArea = [...playArea, ...weapons, ...ammoCards].
- Build ExploreWeapon inputs: weapons.map(id => { const w = cardDef(state, id); return { damage: w?.damage ?? 0, ammoReq: w?.ammoReq ?? 0, weaponEffects: w?.weaponEffects }; }).
- ammo = sum over ammoCards of (cardDef(state, id)?.bonuses?.ammo ?? 0).
- bonusDamage = player.weaponDamageBonusThisTurn.
- Reveal mansion top: `const rev = revealTop({ deck: state.mansionDeck, bottom: state.mansionBottom });` → mansionDeck = rev.mansion.deck; mansionBottom = rev.mansion.bottom; revealedInstanceId = rev.revealedInstanceId. revealedDef = cardDef(state, revealedInstanceId).
- If revealedDef?.type !== 'infected' (non-Infected: items/tokens): create take-or-bottom prompt: prompts += [{ id: 'p' + (state.prompts.length + 1), seat, text: revealedDef?.text ?? '', options: ['Take', 'Send to bottom of Mansion'], payload: { kind: 'takeOrBottom', instanceId: revealedInstanceId } }]. Card stays revealed (not yet moved) until resolved.
- Else (infected): `const outcome = resolveExplore({ weapons: <ExploreWeapon inputs>, ammo, bonusDamage, revealed: revealedDef });`
  - outcome.kind === 'insufficientAmmo' → throw new Error('applyAction: explore: insufficient ammo') (should be unreachable post-validate).
  - defeated: decorations = player.decorations + (revealedDef.decorations ?? 0); attached = [...player.attached, revealedInstanceId]; level-up check: charDef = cardDef(state, player.characterInstanceId); if charDef?.level2At !== undefined → level = levelForDecorations(charDef.level2At, decorations) else level = player.level. THE INFECTED CARD IS ATTACHED (not to bottom). hp/maxHp unchanged.
  - notDefeated: damageTaken = outcome.damageTaken; newHp = Math.max(player.hp - damageTaken, 0); if newHp === 0 → the character flips down: build CharacterState { hp: newHp, maxHp: player.maxHp, decorations: player.decorations, level: player.level, downed: false, dead: false, hand: newHand, discard: player.discard, inventory: player.inventory }, call `flipDown(cs, (items: readonly string[]): string[] => { const r = shuffle(state.rngState, items); newRngState = r.rng; return r.value; })` → write back downed/hand/discard/inventory from the result (attached unchanged). Else (survived) hand/inventory/discard unchanged.
    - Card disposition: if outcome.shuffleBack === true → shuffle the revealed card back: `shuffleBack({ deck: rev.mansion.deck, bottom: rev.mansion.bottom }, revealedInstanceId, <same rngShuffle>)`; else sendToBottom({ deck: rev.mansion.deck, bottom: rev.mansion.bottom }, revealedInstanceId). Update mansionDeck/mansionBottom. (flipDown already used the rng for its own shuffle — if BOTH happen, use the CURRENT rngState from the first shuffle for the second; declare `let currentRng = state.rngState` and thread it through every rng use.)
- Rebuild player (copy all fields), return state.

--- buy { seat, pileId } ---
- player = seats[seat]; pile def: top = state.marketPiles[pileId].cards[0]; cost = cardDef(state, top)?.cost ?? 0.
- b = buyTopCard(state.marketPiles, pileId) → marketPiles = b.market; bought = b.boughtInstanceId.
- turnGold = player.turnGold - cost; buysLeft = player.buysLeft - 1; discard = [...player.discard, bought] (gained card goes to discard).
- Rebuild player, return state.

--- useCharacterAbility { seat, abilityIndex } ---
- v1: no mechanical effect (abilities are hooks). Just rebuild with version+1 + log (copy all arrays).

--- endTurn { seat } ---
- player = seats[seat].
- dh = discardHand({ hand: player.hand, discard: player.discard }); then dh2 = discardHand({ hand: player.playArea, discard: dh.discard }) → hand = [], playArea = [], discard = dh2.discard.
- Draw 5: d = draw({ deck: player.inventory, discard, reshuffledDiscard: [], count: 5 }) → hand = d.hand; inventory = d.deck; discard = d.discard. (Fixture inventories have 8+ cards so no reshuffle.)
- Turn advance: ctx = advanceTurn({ seatCount: state.seats.length, activeSeat: seat, turnNumber: state.turnNumber, aliveSeats: state.seats.filter(s => !s.dead).map(s => s.seat) }) → activeSeat = ctx.activeSeat; turnNumber = ctx.turnNumber.
- Pools are NOT reset here (game.ts turn-start does that). Rebuild player, return state.

--- chooseOption { seat, promptId, option } ---
- prompt = state.prompts.find(p => p.id === promptId) (validate guaranteed it exists, belongs to seat, option in range).
- Prompt removal: prompts = state.prompts.filter(p => p.id !== promptId).
- Resolve by prompt.payload.kind:
  - 'recoverWeaponFromDiscardToHand': chosenId = prompt.options[option]; move it: hand = [...player.hand, chosenId]; discard = player.discard.filter(id => id !== chosenId).
  - 'moveHandCardToTopOfInventory': chosenId = prompt.options[option]; hand = player.hand.filter(id => id !== chosenId); inventory = [chosenId, ...player.inventory].
  - 'trashHandCard': chosenId = prompt.options[option]; hand = player.hand.filter(id => id !== chosenId); removed = [...state.removed, chosenId].
  - 'healGreenHerb': option === 0 → hp = Math.min(player.hp + 20, player.maxHp). option === 1 → hp = Math.min(player.hp + 60, player.maxHp); AND trash one other Green Herb from hand: find first id in hand whose def.type === 'item' and def.id === 'it-1' (use cardDef(state, id)); if found → hand = hand minus it, removed = [...state.removed, thatId]. (The played herb itself is already in removed.)
  - 'lookAtMansionTop': no-op.
  - 'takeOrBottom': option === 0 (Take) → discard = [...player.discard, payload.instanceId] (gained). option === 1 (Send to bottom) → mansionBottom = [...mansionBottom, payload.instanceId].
  - undefined payload → no-op.
- Rebuild player, return state.

```ts
import { applyAction } from './actions';
import type { GameState, CardInstance, CardDef, PlayerState } from '../types';

function seat(s: number, over: Partial<PlayerState> = {}): PlayerState {
  return {
    seat: s, name: 'P' + s, controller: 'human',
    characterInstanceId: 'c' + s, hp: over.hp ?? 100, maxHp: over.maxHp ?? 100,
    decorations: over.decorations ?? 0, level: 1,
    turnAmmo: 0, turnGold: over.turnGold ?? 50, actionsLeft: over.actionsLeft ?? 1,
    buysLeft: over.buysLeft ?? 1, exploresLeft: over.exploresLeft ?? 1,
    weaponDamageBonusThisTurn: over.weaponDamageBonusThisTurn ?? 0, attached: [],
    inventory: over.inventory ?? ['inv1', 'inv2', 'inv3', 'inv4', 'inv5', 'inv6', 'inv7', 'inv8'],
    hand: over.hand ?? ['a1', 'i1', 'am1', 'w1', 'w2'],
    discard: over.discard ?? [], playArea: over.playArea ?? [], downed: false, dead: false,
  };
}

function inst(id: string, cardId: string): CardInstance {
  return { instanceId: id, cardId, location: { zone: 'hand', index: 0, seat: 0 } };
}
```

Write EXACTLY these tests (use toEqual/toBe on the asserted slices; assert via the returned state only):

1. play action card (Deadly Aim): applyAction(baseState(), { type: 'playActionCard', seat: 0, instanceId: 'a1' }) → s.seats[0].hand does NOT contain 'a1'; playArea contains 'a1'; actionsLeft 0; weaponDamageBonusThisTurn 10; s.version 2; s.log.length 1.
2. play action card with bonuses (Merchant): hand ['a2','i1','am1'] → play 'a2' → turnGold 70, buysLeft 2, actionsLeft 0, hand contains 'inv1' (drew 1), hand has no 'a2'.
3. Reload prompt created: hand ['a3'], discard ['dw1'] → play 'a3' → s.prompts.length 1; s.prompts[0].payload.kind 'recoverWeaponFromDiscardToHand'; options ['dw1'] (discard order); seat 0.
4. Reload resolution: after (3), chooseOption { seat: 0, promptId: s.prompts[0].id, option: 0 } → hand contains 'dw1'; discard empty; prompts empty.
5. Umbrella prompt + resolution: hand ['a4', 'w1', 'am1'] → play 'a4' → options equal ['w1', 'am1']; chooseOption option 0 (w1) → hand has no 'w1', inventory top is 'w1' (inventory[0] === 'w1'); prompts empty.
6. Ominous Battle resolution: hand ['a5', 'w1', 'am1'] → play 'a5' → chooseOption option 1 (am1) → hand has no 'am1'; removed contains 'am1'.
7. Green Herb heal 20: seat0 { hp: 50, hand: ['i1'] } → play 'i1' → removed contains 'i1'; prompts.length 1 (kind healGreenHerb); chooseOption option 0 → hp 70.
8. Green Herb heal 60: seat0 { hp: 30, hand: ['i1', 'i2'] } → play 'i1' → chooseOption option 1 → hp 90; hand has no 'i2'; removed contains both 'i1' and 'i2'.
9. First Aid Spray: seat0 { hp: 30, hand: ['i3'] } → play 'i3' → hp 100; removed contains 'i3'; prompts empty.
10. playAmmo: hand ['am1', 'am2'] → play 'am1' → turnAmmo 10; turnGold 60; playArea contains 'am1'; hand has no 'am1'.
11. buy: applyAction(baseState(), { type: 'buy', seat: 0, pileId: 'hg' }) → turnGold 30 (50-20); buysLeft 0; discard contains 'mkr1'; marketPiles.hg.cards [].

(discard was [] — inventory gets ['inv1'..'inv8','w5'] shuffled; just assert length 9 and that it contains 'w5'.)
16. explore Uroboros shuffle-back: mansionDeck ['uro1'], seat0 { hand: ['w5'] } → explore ['w5'] → not defeated (90 hp) → hp 30 (100-70); mansionDeck CONTAINS 'uro1' again (shuffled back) and mansionBottom [] (NOT bottomed); just assert membership.
17. explore non-infected take: mansionDeck ['gh1'], seat0 { hand: ['w5'] } → explore ['w5'] → prompts.length 1; payload.kind 'takeOrBottom'; options ['Take', 'Send to bottom of Mansion']; mansionDeck [] ; chooseOption option 0 → discard contains 'gh1'; prompts empty.

19. endTurn: applyAction(baseState(), { type: 'endTurn', seat: 0 }) → hand length 5 (drew 5); inventory length 3; playArea []; discard contains the 5 discarded hand cards; activeSeat 1; turnNumber 2; hp/maxHp unchanged.

21. invalid action throws: applyAction(baseState(), { type: 'playActionCard', seat: 0, instanceId: 'zzz' }) → expect(...).toThrow('applyAction: playActionCard: unknown card: zzz'); applyAction(baseState(), { type: 'explore', seat: 0, weapons: [], ammoCards: [], exploreCount: 1 }) → toThrow('applyAction: explore: no weapons').
